item.description:

The war “hasn’t impacted our progress,” Mohsin Pirzada, head of funds at Qatar Investment Authority, told Semafor. “We continue to invest, we continue to deploy.” Before the war, QIA said it planned to invest $500 billion in the US alone over the next decade.
